commands.name: ban
commands.description: Removes a member from the server and prevents them from rejoining until they're unbanned.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to ban.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Reason for the ban, shown in the audit log and the DM sent to the user.

arguments.name: delete_messages
arguments.description: How many days of that user's recent messages to delete (0-7).

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Removes a member from the server. They can rejoin with a new invite.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to kick.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Reason for the kick, shown in the audit log.

commands.name: timeout
commands.description: Temporarily removes a member's ability to send messages, add reactions, or join voice channels.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to time out.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: How long the timeout lasts (e.g. 10m, 1h, 1d). Max 28 days.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Reason for the timeout, shown in the audit log.

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Bulk-deletes messages from the current channel, optionally filtered by member or bot.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.description: How many messages to delete (1-100).

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: Only delete messages from this member.

arguments.name: bots_only
arguments.description: Only delete messages sent by bots.

commands.name: warn
commands.description: Records a warning on a member's record, visible to moderators in the case log.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to warn.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.description: Reason for the warning.

commands.name: rank
commands.description: Shows a member's current level, XP progress, and server rank.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to check. Defaults to yourself.

commands.name: leaderboard
commands.description: Displays the server's top members ranked by XP.

arguments.name: page
arguments.description: Which page of the leaderboard to view.

commands.name: setlevel
commands.description: Manually sets a member's level, overriding their current XP.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member whose level you're changing.

arguments.name: level
arguments.description: The level to set them to.

commands.name: poll
commands.description: Posts a reaction-based poll that members can vote on.

arguments.name: question
arguments.description: The question being asked.

arguments.name: options
arguments.description: A comma-separated list of up to 10 answer choices.

arguments.name: duration
arguments.description: How long the poll stays open before results are posted.

commands.name: remind
commands.description: Sets a personal reminder that Hollow will DM you when it's time.

arguments.name: time
arguments.description: When to be reminded (e.g. 20m, 3h, 2d).

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: What to be reminded about.

commands.name: userinfo
commands.description: Looks up account details for a member: join date, account age, and roles.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The member to look up. Defaults to yourself.

commands.name: ai
commands.description: Chats with Hollow's built-in AI assistant, right inside Discord.

arguments.name: prompt
arguments.description: Your question or instruction for the assistant.

arguments.name: model
arguments.description: Which model to use. Defaults to the fastest one.

commands.name: translate
commands.description: Translates a message into another language and posts it in the channel.

arguments.name: text
arguments.description: The text to translate.

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: Target language code (e.g. es, de, ja).

commands.name: reactionrole
commands.description: Attaches a self-assignable role to an emoji reaction on an existing message.

arguments.name: message_id
arguments.description: The ID of the message to attach the reaction role to.

arguments.name: emoji
arguments.description: The emoji members react with to get the role.

arguments.name: role
arguments.description: The role to assign when that emoji is used.

commands.name: autorole
commands.description: Automatically assigns a role to every new member when they join the server.

arguments.name: role
arguments.description: The role to auto-assign on join.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.description: Turn auto-role on or off. Defaults to on.

commands.name: welcome
commands.description: Configures a welcome message posted automatically when a new member joins.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.description: The channel welcome messages should be posted in.

arguments.name: message
arguments.description: Custom message text. Supports {user} and {server} placeholders.

commands.name: customcommand
commands.description: Creates your own command with a custom trigger and response.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: What members type to trigger the command.

arguments.name: response
arguments.description: The reply Hollow sends. Supports variables like {user}.

arguments.name: delete_trigger
arguments.description: Delete the member's message after responding.

commands.name: 8ball
commands.description: Asks the magic 8-ball a question and returns a yes, no, or maybe.

arguments.name: question
arguments.description: The question to ask the 8-ball.

commands.name: coinflip
commands.description: Flips a coin and returns heads or tails.

commands.name: roll
commands.description: Rolls dice and returns the total, e.g. 2d20 for two twenty-sided dice.

arguments.name: dice
arguments.description: Dice notation such as d20, 2d6, or 4d100. Defaults to d20.

commands.name: trivia
commands.description: Starts a timed trivia round in the current channel with points for the winner.

arguments.name: category
arguments.description: Trivia category: general, gaming, music, or science.

arguments.name: difficulty
arguments.description: Easy, medium, or hard. Defaults to medium.

commands.name: meme
commands.description: Posts a random meme from a curated, SFW collection.

arguments.name: subreddit
arguments.description: Only pull memes from this community.

commands.name: ship
commands.description: Calculates a playful compatibility percentage between two members.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The first member.

arguments.name: user2
arguments.description: The second member.

commands.name: play
commands.description: Plays a song from YouTube or Spotify in your voice channel.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: A search term, or a direct YouTube/Spotify link.

commands.name: queue
commands.description: Shows the current play queue with durations and who requested each track.

arguments.name: page
arguments.description: Which page of the queue to view.

commands.name: skip
commands.description: Votes to skip the current track, or skips instantly with the DJ permission.

commands.name: stop
commands.description: Clears the queue and stops playback completely.

commands.name: nowplaying
commands.description: Shows the track currently playing, with a progress bar and requester.

commands.name: lastfm
commands.description: Shows a member's Last.fm profile, or what they're listening to right now.

arguments.name: user
arguments.description: The Discord member whose account to look up. Defaults to yourself.

arguments.name: period
arguments.description: Time range for top stats: week, month, year, or all.

commands.name: spotify
commands.description: Looks up a track, artist, or album on Spotify with a playable preview.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: The track, artist, or album to search for.

arguments.name: type
arguments.description: What to search for: track, artist, or album. Defaults to track.

commands.name: github
commands.description: Shows a GitHub profile or repository, including stars and recent commits.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: A username or owner/repo pair, e.g. hollow-hq/XryWeb.

commands.name: valorant
commands.description: Shows a Valorant account's rank, most-played agents, and recent matches.

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: The Riot account name.

arguments.name: region
arguments.description: Your region: na, eu, ap, kr, or latam.

commands.name: minecraft
commands.description: Shows a player's skin or a Java server's live status and player count.

arguments.name: target
arguments.description: A player username or a server address, e.g. play.example.com.

commands.name: tiktok
commands.description: Looks up a TikTok profile and pulls their latest posts into chat.

arguments.name: username
arguments.description: The TikTok handle, without the @.

commands.name: x
commands.description: Shows an X profile with their recent posts, polls and media.

arguments.name: username
arguments.description: The X handle, without the @.

arguments.name: count
arguments.description: How many recent posts to show (1-10). Defaults to 5.
